observations: The page number «38» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01: «Monate» continues «Die Tafel 2b enthält die ägyptischen (koptischen)» at the end of p. 37 (JP2 0069, L36). L06-L07: the heading of chapter 5, in bold, centred, with the reference to the text below it.

L22-L24: the computation of the first example, set as a small table: the years («J.»), months («M.») and days («T.») in columns, repeated by ditto marks „ in L23 and L24, those of L23 also under «der röm. Aera»; L24, «Summa :» and the sum, stands below a rule under the figures of L23. Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|»; the empty cells give the words room and are not printed.

L22-L32. Checked: with years of 365¼ days and months of 30 days (note 4), 1427 years 7 months 5¼ days are 521427 days, which lead from 1 October 312 B.C. exactly to 1 Muḥarram 511 counted from the epoch of the tables (seventeen cycles of 10631 days after 15 July 622), Friday 4 May 1117; 8 years 8 months 27 days are 3189 days, the nine Arab years 511-519 (three of them leap years); the sum is 1436 years 3 months 32¼ days; less 5¼ days for the twelve months counted as a year, and two days for October and December, it is 1436 years 3 months 25 days, which lead to 26 January 1126 (1 October 1125 is the beginning of the Seleucid year 1437), the date of p. 37 (JP2 0069, L10-L17).

L20, L31-L33: «1. Muḥarram», «26. Kānūn II.», «26. Januar», «5. Radjab» in italics with their numbers. Spaced type: «Ptol.», «Nallino», «Al-Bīrūnīs», «Batt.», «Kh.», «Sachau». N02: the words from «u. 199» to the end of the note are printed heavier than its beginning (strokes of 5 px against 4 px), a difference of inking. N01: a speck above the line after the note number; not transcribed.
The colons, semicolons and question marks stand after the thin space of the edition (10-13 px measured; «Summa :» 10 px, «d. H. ?» 11 and 13 px).
